type.description: Note type driving the applied standard (different types, different expectations — never one-size-fits-all).

standards_version.description: Version of the deterministic standard definitions; scores are comparable across iterations only within the same version.

sequence_hint.description: Generation-order hint used by drift detection (frontmatter index preferred, natural filename order fallback).

score.description: 0..1 deterministic score, or null when the dimension is unmeasured (e.g. source coverage without a provenance mapping). Unmeasured is never guessed.

evidence.description: Machine evidence for the score (counts, thresholds, line references).

uncovered.description: source_coverage only: mapped source KUs not represented in the note, with reasons and terms.

overall.description: Weighted mean over measured dimensions (renormalized when some are unmeasured); null when nothing is measurable.

caveat.description: Standing caveat: deterministic measurement only; semantic adequacy is a review decision.
